message.content:
In 2015 the **World Chess Championship** took place from November 2‑12 in Chennai, India.  
It featured reigning champion **Magnus Carlsen** defending his title against challenger **Sergey Karjakin**.  

Carlsen successfully defended his crown, winning the match 6½–4½ after nine games plus two rapid tiebreakers. Thus, **Magnus Carlsen remained the World Champion** following the 2015 event.
